_comment: memory:false disables the Observer/Reflector/Dropper LLM workers (no background bookkeeping; re-enable with /blackhole om-on). compactionEngine: blackhole = deterministic structural summaries. skipForProviders: on claude-bridge models the bridge's own compaction takeover handles summaries; blackhole owns compaction on every other provider. TRIGGER POLICY (2026-09-28): per-session-type ABSOLUTE thresholds via launcher env PI_BLACKHOLE_COMPACT_AFTER_TOKENS — local (pi/beta) 240000, cloud (pihat/betahat) 350000. The samuel preset mirrors that policy for env-less launches: 262144 cap -> 240k, 400000 cap -> 350k, 1M -> 350k. tailBehavior pi-default: keep pi's ~20k verbatim tail at the compaction cut instead of only the last user message (LangWatch preserved-tail recommendation). debugLog: set true to write ~/.pi/agent/pi-blackhole/debug.ndjson.
